research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: HistoWiz is engaged in developing systems and methods for automated tagging of features in digital micrographs representing tissue sample slides, as described in 'Systems and methods for automated tagging of digital histology slides.' Additionally, they focus on automated quality control analysis of digital micrographs, as outlined in 'Systems and methods for multi-stage quality control of digital micrographs.' These efforts center on enhancing automation in histopathology slide analysis and quality assurance.

overview_description.description:
HistoWiz is a biotech company that automates the processing and digitizing of tissue samples for pharma and academia.

Through its fully automated histology lab and the world’s first online pathologist network, HistoWiz processes and annotates tissue samples which are stored on PathologyMap, its cloud database, as a resource for cancer researchers.

The data stored on PathologyMap enables the integration of technology and the development of AI tools for digital pathology on an unprecedented scale.

about_short_description.short_description: HistoWiz provides automated histopathology for biomedical researchers.

product.name: Precision Histology
product.description: Tissue processing and slide generation services that convert biomedical research specimens into histology slides and digital images.

product.name: PathologyMap™
product.description: A cloud-based digital pathology platform for viewing, managing, annotating, sharing, and collaborating on whole-slide images.

product.name: Immunostaining
product.description: Immunohistochemistry and immunofluorescence staining services for visualizing proteins and other tissue markers in research specimens.

product.name: Path Consult
product.description: Online pathology consultation and reporting from board-certified human and veterinary pathologists for research studies.

product.name: Image Analysis
product.description: Quantitative analysis of digital pathology images to produce objective, measurable assessments of tissue features and staining results.

product.name: Slide Archiving
product.description: High-throughput digitization and scanning of glass slide collections for online storage, viewing, and research access.
